slides.author: Alexey Grigorev
slides.title: Pointless tests
slides.subtitle: AI agents can generate tests that look useful but check almost nothing.

slides.title: Bad signal
slides.body: Tests that check imports, method names, or prompt wording can make a project look safer than it is.

slides.title: Better signal
slides.body: For an agent, test behavior: expected tool calls, useful answers, safety boundaries, and stopping conditions.

slides.title: Why first
slides.body: Clean tests before cleaning code. Tests are the thing you trust while changing everything else.

slides.title: Rule
slides.body: With AI-generated code, reviewing tests is part of owning the system.
